<noinclude>
'''Champlain Group navigation card.''' One card in the Main Page contents grid.

Usage:
<pre>{{CG-NavCard
| link  = Orion Arm
| title = Orion Arm
| desc  = Charted space, sectors, and sovereign territories.
| image = Orion Arm Card.jpg
| alt   = Nebula over a charted star sector
}}</pre>
All parameters required except <code>alt</code> (falls back to the title).
</noinclude><includeonly><div class="cg-card">
<div class="cg-card-img">[[File:{{{image}}}|300px|link={{{link}}}|alt={{{alt|{{{title}}}}}}]]</div>
<div class="cg-card-body">[[{{{link}}}|<span class="cg-card-title">{{{title}}}</span>]]<div class="cg-card-desc">{{{desc}}}</div></div>
</div></includeonly>
